# "A Day in the Life of Insects: Bees" - A Ugandan Filmmaker's Cut

> Independent documentary film project by Ugandan filmmaker Nathan Binomugisha exploring the secret world of bees in East Africa.

## Project Overview
- **Title**: A Day in the Life of Insects: Bees. A Ugandan Filmmaker's Cut
- **Filmmaker**: Nathan Binomugisha (Independent Wildlife & Documentary Filmmaker)
- **Location**: Uganda, East Africa
- **Fundraising Goal**: $15,000 USD
- **Timeline**: 
  - December 2025 - March 2026: Pre-production
  - February - August 2026: Production & macro filming
  - September 2026 - March 2027: Post-production & scoring
- **Official Website**: https://series.binomugisha.org/
- **Main Portfolio**: https://binomugisha.org/

## Previous Work
- **The Fascinating World of Dragonflies, Beetles, and Millipedes**: https://youtu.be/O8u0B6tG-Mc
